Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] '''researcher''' sought to discover the "real natives of [[Quockra-4]]." He offered a reward of up to 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to entice traders to seek out information on the architects of the exotic [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on Quockra-4. This led to some adventurers exploring tunnels below the planet's surface, encountering numerous groups of droids along the way&mdash;who progressively ignored them, ordered them to leave, and finally attacked them&mdash;before discovering the droids' creators: the [[Quockran]]s. These Quockrans refused to communicate with the adventurers.
